title: DR Attestation
description: A verifiable attestation derived from a DR transcript. Compact form suitable for embedding in proofofship envelopes and profiles.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be '0.1' for this schema.

transcript_id.description: Reference to the full DR transcript this attestation summarises.

attested_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the attestation was produced.

github_username.description: GitHub username of the actor being attested.

orcid.description: Optional ORCID iD for the actor.

score.description: Aggregate DR score from the transcript (0 = no signal, 1 = maximum signal).

signal.description: Decision signal from the DR engine.

readiness.description: Overall readiness score derived from the transcript.

total_rounds.description: Number of evaluation rounds in the source transcript.

novelty_rate.description: Average novelty rate across rounds — how much new signal each round contributed.

context_ref.description: Optional URL referencing the work item this attestation covers (e.g. GitHub PR or issue).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical transcript JSON, for tamper evidence.
